description:
Reply by DM to someone who messaged this account in the last 24 hours, in that same conversation (recipient_id from instagram_list_all_conversations / instagram_list_all_messages). Cannot start a conversation or message someone who has not written: Instagram refuses it with error code messaging_window_closed (do not retry). For a first message, use instagram_actions_send_message (Advanced plan). Requires an Instagram Business or Creator account.

Bulk support: accepts ig_user_ids, recipient_ids, reply_to_message_ids for batched execution.
name: instagram_send_text_message
